recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. The current core source already satisfies the published FHIR-13601 decision and later related target-scope fixes; no additional edit is needed unless a future build-scope review reactivates or removes retained ClinicalImpression source.
issue_request: FHIR-13601 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request raised in STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that the common clinical-patient search parameter appeared to target both Patient and Group, contrary to the patient-vs-subject convention, and the approved resolution was to remove "or Group" from the Encounter and ClinicalImpression patient search parameter descriptions because those expressions already filtered to Patient while subject covers Patient or Group.
initial_application: Commit f3156be190fa6b0dcc3acec5f7ef59db4d052b27 applied the issue by changing ClinicalImpression-patient from "Patient or group assessed" to "Patient assessed" and Encounter-patient from "The patient or group present at the encounter" to "The patient present at the encounter". Later history preserved that Patient-only scope, including the FHIR-20479 wording update that changed Encounter-patient to "The patient related to this encounter" without adding Group.
additional_context: FHIR-15903 and FHIR-28219 confirmed the broader rule that patient search parameters should target Patient only and subject parameters should be used for Patient-or-Group searches. FHIR-31714 addressed the generated/downloaded target-list defect by adding explicit target declarations for constrained reference SearchParameters, and FHIR-32876 was closed as a duplicate after the reporter confirmed the build showed target ["Patient"]. ClinicalImpression was later mirrored/renamed as ClinicalAssessment, and both retained/renamed patient search parameter bundles use Patient-only descriptions, expressions, and targets. source/fhir.ini actively lists Encounter and SearchParameter, while ClinicalImpression/ClinicalAssessment are not active current [resources] entries.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current Encounter-patient, ClinicalImpression-patient, and ClinicalAssessment-patient definitions all use Patient-only wording, filter subject to Patient, and declare target Patient. The common clinical-patient source block contains no Group target in the audited block, and subject search parameters remain Patient-or-Group as intended.

related_jiras.note: Raised the same clinical-patient Patient-vs-Group scope problem across resources and resolved that patient parameters should target Patient while subject parameters cover Patient or Group.
Confirmed common clinical-patient should have a single Patient target and subject-based expressions should use where(resolve() is Patient).
Fixed the generated target-list problem for constrained reference SearchParameters by ensuring narrowed target declarations are present.
Duplicate of FHIR-31714 that references FHIR-13601/FHIR-15903 and records that R4B/R5 later showed target ["Patient"].
Updated Encounter patient/subject descriptions from "present" to "related" while preserving the FHIR-13601 patient-only scope for Encounter-patient.
Renamed/mirrored ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment; the corresponding patient search parameter retained Patient-only wording and target.
